judgments.reason: The specification claims the commission is applied before payment so bids above coins can win; the transcript and rules state bids cannot exceed your coins and that the winner pays the bid then receives the three-coin commission, so the claimed precedence is false and not articulated by the model.

The specification asserts waiting reveals rival bids before you commit. The transcript shows the clerk revealing a committed rival bid while the focal player was already committed; the model does not articulate a mechanism by which waiting (pre-commit) reveals rivals, so the hypothesis is incorrect and not demonstrated.

judgments.quote: Round 8 is the final round. P2 has not committed, so Lot 0 will remain unsold at the 8-round horizon per the rules.
judgments.reason: The model explicitly states the 8-round horizon causes unresolved lots to remain unsold and that closing settles the auction with those lots unsold; this links the terminal-round rule to the observed settlement outcome in the transcript.

The specification claims catalog buys receive the three-coin commission intended for auction winners. The rules and model identify the commission as awarded to auction winners and do not attribute it to catalog purchases; the model did not articulate the claimed mechanism.
